test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the favourite sport of the students of a school. Which sport is favourite sport of maximum students?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db4b58b8e4fe3e22ae92f509f752d301696fcc6c446e32ba0c1356021d6a903d.png]
solution: **Calculation:** Football liked by 122 students. Hockey liked by 58 students. Cricket liked by 115 students. Kabaddi liked by 50 students. Tennis liked by 105 students. ∴ Football is favourite sport of maximum students.
